_meta.description: Equipment footprint dimensions for plant layout generation. All dimensions in metres. Model names validated from PROMAN PFDs (2026). Dimensions are engineering approximations — replace with actual PROMAN GA drawings.
_meta.confirm_note: Model names confirmed from PFDs. Physical dimensions still require PROMAN OEM GA drawings.

1300x5600.label: VGF 1.3m x 5.6m
1300x5600.note: Used in 300 TPH and 600 TPH 3-stage PFDs. Feed 0-650/750mm.

PROJaw_3624.label: PROJaw 3624
PROJaw_3624.note: Used in 150 TPH 2-stage & 3-stage. CSS 110mm for granite.

PROJaw_4230.label: PROJaw 4230 (42x30)
PROJaw_4230.note: Used in 250 TPH (CSS 110-127mm) and 300 TPH limestone (CSS 152mm). Versatile mid-range jaw.

PROJaw_49x38.label: PROJaw 49x38 (Hcy-1250x950)
PROJaw_49x38.note: Used in 600 TPH 3-stage (Gabro). Hydraulic jaw (Hcy). CSS 125mm. Feed 0-750mm.

PROCone_3510.label: PROCone-3510
PROCone_3510.note: Used in 150 TPH 2-stage (CSS 32) and 3-stage (CSS 28). Secondary stage.

PROCone_4510.label: PROCone-4510
PROCone_4510.note: Used in 250 TPH 2-stage (CSS 30) and 3-stage (CSS 32). Mid-range secondary cone.

PROCone_5010.label: PROCone-5010
PROCone_5010.note: Used in 300 TPH (CSS 34) and 600 TPH twin-cone (CSS 28, 2x400HP). Largest PROMAN cone.

REMco_VSI200.label: PROMAN REMco VSI-200
REMco_VSI200.note: Tertiary VSI. Used in 150 TPH 3-stage. 110 mt/h input in tertiary-only config. Feed 0-30mm.

REMco_VSI300.label: PROMAN REMco VSI-300
REMco_VSI300.note: Tertiary VSI. Used in 250 TPH 3-stage and tertiary-only VSI-300 config (200 mt/h basalt). Feed 0-40mm.

REMco_VSI4060.label: PROMAN REMco VSI-4060
REMco_VSI4060.note: Tertiary VSI. Used in 300 TPH 3-stage (limestone). 2x300 HP motors.

REMco_VSI5080.label: PROMAN REMco VSI-5080
REMco_VSI5080.note: Tertiary VSI. Used in 600 TPH 3-stage and tertiary-only VSI-5080 config (600 mt/h granite). 2x400 HP. Feed 0-50mm.

2000x6000_4d.label: Screen 2.0m x 6.0m 4-Deck
2000x6000_4d.note: Used in 150 TPH 2-stage (final), 250 TPH 3-stage (intermediate), and tertiary VSI-200/VSI-300 configs.

2400x8100_3d.label: Screen 2.4m x 8.1m 3-Deck
2400x8100_3d.note: Used in 600 TPH 3-stage (×2 intermediate, ×2 final). Also tertiary VSI-5080 config.

WSG70.label: ORTNER WSG-70 (Wet Sand Plant)
WSG70.note: Wet sand washing add-on. Requires sump, pump, water supply.

MVF_100160.label: Mechanical Feeder 1.0m x 1.6m
MVF_100160.note: Surge-bin discharge feeder. Seen in 250 TPH 3-stage (2 units: 1.0x1.6m each).
